title: Performance
description: Can measure, profile, benchmark, cache and load-test so a capacity claim cites a run — and can reject a speedup that is only a story.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can run a documented harness that prints p50/p95/p99, write an SLI and an SLO before looking at results, and record hardware plus warmup — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can commit a pre-profile hypothesis, name the hottest CPU and allocation frames from profile files, and report a cache hit rate as counted hits/(hits+misses) with a p95 delta.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently step load to the knee where the SLO fails, quote a measured saturation signal at that point, and compute replica count from those numbers with the arithmetic written out.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a speedup that is variance, a cache that moves p95 but serves stale data, or a capacity note that invents RPS, and produce a note another engineer can re-run from one command.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's harness or capacity note, name a mean-only benchmark or an uncited input, and teach when to trust a profile over a guess on an unfamiliar service.
